discrepancy_analysis: Both arms score ~69.5, confirming the SA plateau. The predicted improvement from post-SA optimization is at best marginal (~0.01 points, within noise). The key iter-2 finding is negative: no tested improvement to the SA framework (NN-guided moves, double-bridge, Or-opt, Hilbert construction, exact deltas, edge targeting) meaningfully improves on random swap SA. Breaking past 69.5 requires a fundamentally different approach (LK-style moves, divide-and-conquer, or better construction heuristic).
